Place

Class

A thing that is individuated by its position relative to other things - such as being enclosed by an object, being to the left side of an object, or being immediately North of another place

Note

The matter that is hosted in a place makes no difference for the individuation of that place: a room remains in existence irrespective of whether it hosts an absolute vacuum, a few pieces of furniture and regular air, or a giant load of cotton wool

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
